name: Padlock
summary: Chunky padlock with keyhole and a shackle that can animate open or closed; for security and access scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the lock stands on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 about 300 px wide and hero size; use about 0.3 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: open = shackle lifts and swings back in, close = shackle drops shut; both loop every 90 frames

author: krakujs
